div.head: VI Atr 22.3
div.ab: ⁊ to æghwilces apostoles heahtide fæste man georne, butan to Philippus ⁊ Iacobus freolse ne beode we nan fæsten for þam easterlican freolse, butan hwa wille; elles oþre freolsa ⁊ fæstena healde man georne, swa swa þa heoldan þa þe betst heoldan,

And to æghwilces apostoles heahtide fæste man georne, buton Philippus ⁊ Iacobus freolse ne beode we nán fæsten for ðam eastran dæges freolse; elles oðre freolsa ⁊ fæstena healde man georne, swa swa þa heoldon þa ðe betst heoldon,
⁊ to æghwilces apostoles heahtide fæste man georne, butan to Philippus ⁊ Iacobus freolse ne beode we nan fæsten for þam easterlican freolse, butan hwa wille.
And to æghwilces apostoles heahtide fæste man georne, butan to Philippus and Iacobus freolse ne beode we nan fæsten for þam Easterlican freolse, butan hwa wille.

Und zu jeden Apostels Festzeit faste man willig; nur zum Philippus und Jacobusfeste [1. Mai] gebieten wir kein Fasten wegen des österlichen (Ostertages D) Festes, ausser wer freiwill[ig fastet K]; andere Feste und Fasten sonst halte man willig, so wie jene, welche [sie] bestens hielten, gehalten haben,

And at the festival of every apostle let there be eager fasting; only for the feast of Philip and James [1 May] we command no fast, because of the Easter (Easter Day's, D) festival, except for whoever wishes [to fast, K]; other feasts and fasts otherwise let them be eagerly kept, as those kept them who kept them best,

And at the festival of every apostle fasting shall be strictly observed, except that at the festival of Philip and James we enjoin no fast, because of the Easter festival, unless anyone desires to fast.
And one must fast readily for the feast of each apostle, but we order no fast for the Feasts of Philip and James because of Easter, unless one wishes to do so.
